title: Triangulated closure for ell-adic finiteness coefficients
statement: Let X be a scheme with noetherian underlying space and let Λ satisfy IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ell Λ. The bounded complexes of module objects over condensedRingObj Λ X with stratified locally finitely presented homology form a triangulated subcategory of the ambient derived category.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3); Serre heart-closure input for lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves, step 10

proof.text: For a finite normed field extension E of Q_ell, transfer the continuous coefficient sheaf to its universe-lifted realization and apply local finite freeness. The generic locally-free Serre proof gives kernel, cokernel and extension closure on noetherian strata. For the bounded-image algebraic-closure coefficient sheaf use its proved constructible Serre theorem. Turn the chosen-kernel and chosen-cokernel closures into closures for arbitrary limit and colimit cones by their unique isomorphisms. Use the public constructible_of_iso transport lemma, passing the coefficient ring by its implicit R argument.

For the integral constructor equip E with its norm induced from the fixed algebraic closure; its integer ring is definitionally the continuous closed unit ball. Apply the proved integral Serre theorem. For a supplied unit-ball subring O use the membership hypothesis to identify O with continuousIntegers and apply the same theorem. In every coefficient case the conditional derived homology-property theorem turns these three Serre closures into triangulated closure. Apply isTriangulated_boundedConstructible_of_serre explicitly rather than synthesizing an unrestricted triangulation instance.
